scenario.task:
My home Wi-Fi isn't working, and I want to check if there is an active internet outage in my area (postal code H3Z 2Y7)

User Guide: The user is calling because their internet is down. They provide postal code H3Z 2Y7 when prompted and eagerly accept the offer for SMS restoration updates If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
